subject: Welcome to Orbit - your onboarding checklist
body:
Hi Alex,

We look forward to your October 19 start. Please complete your People Portal profile by October 15; that releases your screening invitation. Your payroll payment preference is due October 20 and should be entered directly in the secure portal.

The attached checklist separates each task. We are still confirming the laptop appointment.

Best,
Jordan
